issues.location: Products with 50+ reviews convert at 2-3x versus products with no reviews (Bazaarvoice / Spiegel Research Center)
issues.explanation: This is a debunked fabricated benchmark. Spiegel Research Center found that 5 reviews (not 50+) produced a 270% conversion lift. The '50+ reviews at 2-3x' figure is not from Spiegel or Bazaarvoice and is listed as a known fabricated stat to flag.

issues.location: Ahrefs: Unique product descriptions increase organic traffic per PDP by 30-50%
issues.explanation: This statistic — that unique descriptions increase traffic by 30-50% — has never been published by Ahrefs. It is a known fabricated benchmark listed in the check criteria. It also appears in the References section, lending it false credibility.

issues.location: Rich snippets increase CTR by 20-40% according to Search Engine Journal and Ahrefs research
issues.explanation: Search Engine Journal is a generic SEO blog, not a primary research source. Citing it alongside Ahrefs for a specific quantified benchmark (20-40% CTR lift) does not meet the standard of credible business intelligence. Neither source is a peer-reviewed or methodologically rigorous study.

issues.location: Bazaarvoice / Spiegel Research Center: Products with 50+ reviews convert at 2-3x vs. no reviews
issues.explanation: Repeated in the References section. The '50+ reviews convert at 2-3x' figure is a known debunked benchmark. Spiegel Research Center's actual finding was that 5 reviews drive a 270% lift, not 50+ reviews at 2-3x.

issues.location: Ahrefs: Unique product descriptions increase organic traffic per PDP by 30-50%
issues.explanation: Appears again in the References section. Ahrefs has never published this specific statistic. It is a known fabricated benchmark.

summary: The report contains three distinct fabricated benchmarks (50+ reviews at 2-3x conversion, unique descriptions +30-50% traffic, both falsely attributed to Spiegel/Bazaarvoice and Ahrefs respectively) and relies on a generic SEO blog as a source for a quantified CTR claim; all other checks pass.

edits.original: Products with 50+ reviews convert at 2-3x versus products with no reviews (Bazaarvoice / Spiegel Research Center).
edits.fixed: Products with 5 or more reviews see a 270% higher purchase likelihood versus products with no reviews (Spiegel Research Center, 2017).
edits.rationale: The '50+ reviews at 2-3x' figure is a known fabricated benchmark. Spiegel Research Center's actual finding was that 5+ reviews produce a 270% lift in purchase likelihood.

edits.original: Rich snippets increase CTR by 20-40% according to Search Engine Journal and Ahrefs research.
edits.fixed: Rich snippets have been widely reported to increase CTR, though estimates vary by industry and query type.
edits.rationale: Neither Search Engine Journal nor Ahrefs is a rigorous primary source for this specific quantified claim. Removing the fabricated 20-40% figure and softening the claim to reflect the general consensus without an unverifiable number.
